heading: Quakecon
title: Quakecon Convention
summary: A various ready-to-use string casing utilities in Typescript.

body.raw:
![Quakecon](/static/images/blog2025/QuakeconLogo.png)
### Quakecon 2025!

I have been going to Quakecon since 2005 and have not missed a year yet (except during COVID when it was canceled).
It is always my one time a year to spend time with old gaming friends and just chill. Honestly in the past we do more
hanging out than we do gaming. Either way I will try to share pictures/videos for Quakecon 2025 this year on this snippets
page.

<center>
[![Click Here](/static/images/blog2025/QuakeconAlbum2025.png)](https://www.icloud.com/sharedalbum/#B275Uzl7VGGuhG0)
</center>
